title: Find a Grave memorial 190642286 — Ronald E. Totosz
citation: Find a Grave, memorial 190642286, "Ronald E. Totosz" (1941–2004), Chapel Hill Gardens, Merle Hay mausoleum, Des Moines, Polk County, Iowa. Memorial created 16 June 2018; niche photograph added 11 April 2022.
notes: Confirms his burial in Des Moines, and was the first record to connect the phonetic "Tototz" Larry remembered to the spelling Totosz. A user-contributed database rather than an official record: good evidence of dates and place of burial, and not independent of the obituary for anything else.
